result.title: Less Loss, Fixed Weights: Logit Corrections for Forgetting
result.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/SeverinVisionary/prior-shift-diagnostic
result.summary: When a language model is fine-tuned to follow instructions, or further pretrained on a new subject, it often gets worse at predicting standard web text. This is known as "forgetting." We ask whether this loss can be undone by simple, fixed adjustments to the model's final token predictions. Across 14 pairs of base and derived models, from 1B to 7B parameters, we fitted a fixed bonus or penalty for each token (a vocabulary bias), alone or together with a temperature. On text held out from correction fitting, the largest top-4K bias recovery estimate is under 10%, with loss conditional on the retained vocabulary. Combining the bias with a temperature recovers up to 36%. Models further pretrained on math lose the most and recover almost nothing. Finally, in a controlled simulation where a model is damaged at random, with no planted bias or temperature change, the bias-plus-temperature fix still recovers 29%. Most of the real-model loss increase stays out of reach of our restricted fits.

AI.brief_summary: 在14对1B–7B基座与派生模型上，拟合固定词表偏置（单独或配合温度）以检验简单的输出端 logit 修正能否挽回微调或继续预训练带来的损失；结果显示恢复有限（偏置不足10%，加温度最高36%），数学继续预训练几乎无法恢复。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定偏置+温度」的输出端校正可作为核查 LVR 收益是否仅源于输出分布校准的对照基线，负结果也暗示损失主要来自内部状态而非输出层；但属纯文本、非多模态工作，迁移线索待核查。
